title: MPP one-time charge over HTTP (tempo method, charge intent)
summary: The default MPP path. The server answers an unpaid request with 402 and a WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge, the client signs a Tempo transfer and retries with Authorization: Payment, and the server verifies, broadcasts and returns 200 with Payment-Receipt.

steps.label: GET /v1/forecast (optional Accept-Payment)
steps.detail: The client asks for the resource with no credential. It may state the method and intent pairs it can use, with q weights. The server must treat Accept-Payment as a hint only.

payload.content:
GET /v1/forecast HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Accept-Payment: tempo/charge, stripe/charge;q=0.5

steps.label: 402 with WWW-Authenticate: Payment
steps.detail: The server returns 402 with Cache-Control no-store and one challenge per offer. The id is an HMAC over realm, method, intent, request and expires, so the server can verify it later without storage. The request value is base64url JCS JSON with the amount in base units.

payload.content:
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Cache-Control: no-store
Content-Type: application/problem+json
WWW-Authenticate: Payment id="kM9xPqWvT2nJrHsY4aDfEb",
    realm="api.example.com",
    method="tempo",
    intent="charge",
    expires="2026-10-11T12:05:00Z",
    request="eyJhbW91bnQiOiIxMDAwMCIsLi4ufQ"

{"type":"https://paymentauth.org/problems/payment-required","title":"Payment Required","status":402,"challengeId":"kM9xPqWvT2nJrHsY4aDfEb"}

# decoded request (Illustrative example, spec version draft-tempo-charge-00; Moderato testnet, placeholder addresses)
{
  "amount": "10000",
  "currency": "0x20c0000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  "recipient": "0xB0B0000000000000000000000000000000000B0B",
  "methodDetails": { "chainId": 42431, "feePayer": true }
}

failures.outcome: Server answers 401 first and issues the Payment challenge only after authentication.

steps.label: Decode request and check terms
steps.detail: The client decodes request and checks amount, currency, recipient and expires against what it expected. It must not trust description. It then signs a Tempo transaction calling transfer, valid no later than expires; with feePayer true it leaves the fee for the server.

failures.outcome: Client must not pay; it requests a new challenge.

failures.condition: Amount or recipient differ from policy

steps.label: Retry with Authorization: Payment
steps.detail: The client sends the same request again with the base64url credential: the echoed challenge, an optional DID source and the method payload. An Idempotency-Key is advised for non-idempotent methods.

payload.content:
GET /v1/forecast HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Payment eyJjaGFsbGVuZ2UiOnsiaWQiOi...

# decoded credential (Illustrative example, spec version draft-httpauth-payment-01)
{
  "challenge": {
    "id": "kM9xPqWvT2nJrHsY4aDfEb",
    "realm": "api.example.com",
    "method": "tempo",
    "intent": "charge",
    "request": "eyJhbW91bnQiOiIxMDAwMCIsLi4ufQ",
    "expires": "2026-10-11T12:05:00Z"
  },
  "payload": { "type": "transaction", "signature": "0x76f9...signed transaction bytes" },
  "source": "did:pkh:eip155:42431:0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678"
}

failures.condition: Credential sent in a field the challenge did not select

steps.label: Verify binding, expiry and proof
steps.detail: The server recomputes the HMAC over the echoed parameters, checks that the id is unused and not expired, decodes the signed transaction and checks token, amount, recipient and validBefore.

steps.label: Co-sign fee and broadcast
steps.detail: In pull mode the server adds its fee payer signature and broadcasts the transfer. Tempo blocks arrive about every 600 ms with deterministic finality.

failures.condition: Transaction reverts or is not included
failures.outcome: 402 with a fresh challenge; no receipt.

steps.label: Transfer confirmed
steps.detail: The server reads the receipt of the transaction and records the challenge id as consumed so concurrent retries settle at most once.

steps.label: 200 OK with Payment-Receipt
steps.detail: The server returns the resource with Cache-Control private and a base64url receipt whose reference is the Tempo transaction hash. Receipts never appear on error responses.

payload.content:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: private
Payment-Receipt: eyJzdGF0dXMiOiJzdWNjZXNzIiwi...
Content-Type: application/json

# decoded receipt (Illustrative example, spec version draft-httpauth-payment-01)
{
  "status": "success",
  "method": "tempo",
  "timestamp": "2026-10-11T12:00:03Z",
  "reference": "0x1a2b...7890"
}

failures.condition: Payment valid but policy denies access
